Some useful tips this busy block
Autumn is here
Travel comfort needs are getting extra attention at Aurelia Skyways, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is moving fast to keep every animal trip smooth and calm. Companion Animal Travel Desk team members are checking welfare notes, lining up the right forms, and pushing clear guidance to travelers before small issues turn into big delays. If a pet is uneasy or a booking looks shaky, flag it right away so the right help can step in.

On the traveler side, the passenger coordinator is spelling out the required steps in plain language, which helps cut confusion and keeps handoffs clean. That kind of steady, direct support matters for every family on the move, especially when pets need a little extra care. Stay alert, keep answers simple, and make sure no comfort concern gets brushed aside.
